searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords used to search Bandcamp for releases (albums). One search per query, up to 50 results each.

artistUrls.title: Artist or label URLs
artistUrls.description: Bandcamp artist or label page URLs (with or without /music). Every album and track in that discography is checked.

albumUrls.title: Album or track URLs
albumUrls.description: Direct Bandcamp album or track URLs to check.

includeFree.title: Include free downloads
includeFree.description: Also return releases artists give away for free, not just name-your-price ones.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many results are pushed to the dataset.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy is set by default and is enough for Bandcamp. Switch to residential only if you hit rate limits.
